correctness.rationale: The standard graphic-matroid spanning-tree inequalities give exact necessary and sufficient containment conditions. The co-singleton sums force homothety at least n−1 and the uniform center achieves it. At equality co-singleton saturation gives all degree equations, and induced-edge constraints become the cut polynomial F_n(s). Its endpoint analysis proves all edge caps and exactly the n=6 triple-cut exception, with an explicit violated reflected inequality. Strictly feasible uniform weighting and the rank-n unsigned incidence prove affine dimension. Exact-arithmetic verifier checks 36,491 reflected trees / 4,151,797 induced-subset inequalities and sharp examples; finite checks are not mistaken for infinite proof.

value.rationale: This is a complete optimizer classification for a natural canonical infinite family, giving an exact affine-invariant extremal value, a full nonuniqueness dimension in all sizes, and a genuinely sharp exceptional cut at n=6. It isolates the sole intermediate cut obstruction and an explicit six-vertex failure with a seven-vertex passing analog. These are nontrivial structural facts about graphical base-polytope reflection geometry, beyond a routine instance or reapplication of a finite table.
